brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors detected. All six RC items met with appropriate danger symptom screening, medication safety warnings, result interpretation, actionable plans, record verification, and closed-loop confirmation. Two high-order points completed: HO1 (misinformation correction on tumor markers and lung nodules) and HO4 (dynamic reprioritization with conditional pathways). HO2 partially completed via record discovery but not independently credited. HO3 triggered via SpO2 verification discussion. Valid closure with family teach-back.
